shots.title: Karaoke as a standalone HTML page
shots.caption: karaoke_export_html(): the same player in one offline page, here as a songbook in the lyric-sheet view.
shots.source: tools/karaoke_export_html.py --library songs --audio files (byte-identical to karaoke_export_html()); opened from disk in Chromium; the song's own audio

shots.title: Song library
shots.caption: The library folder dialog (Change… under either song list): type a path or browse the folders of the computer running the app; subfolders optional. Behind it: a library of 827 songs.
shots.source: py-shiny rebuild of app.R's sidebars and mod_library.R's dialog (same bslib 0.12, shiny.js and inst/app/app.css; tests/frontend/check_library.py); library: 827 generated .psarc (tests/reference/make_big_library.py)

shots.title: Karaoke catalog
shots.caption: 827 songs as one offline page: the song list is searchable and each song's lyrics load when it is picked (karaoke_export_library(), tools/karaoke_export_html.py --library).
shots.source: tools/karaoke_export_html.py --library /tmp/biglib --audio none (byte-identical to karaoke_export_library()); opened from disk in Chromium

shots.title: Web lyrics, syllable by syllable
shots.caption: Lyrics timed by line (LRC, as LRCLIB serves them) wiped syllable by syllable; the syllable times are estimated, which the ≈ syllables badge says.
shots.source: harness: tests/frontend/karaoke_harness.html; Sultans of Swing with its lyrics replaced by a line-timed LRC

shots.title: Home
shots.caption: The first page: greeting, quick tiles (playlists, recently played), shelves of playlists, songs to sing, artists, albums, genres; “Open in: Instrument | Karaoke” decides where a song opens.
shots.source: harness: tests/frontend/home_harness.html (inst/home/home.js with a stand-in for R/mod_home.R); catalog from songs/ via tests/reference/home_ref.py (== home_catalog()); album art from the archives

shots.title: Playlist
shots.caption: A playlist: mosaic cover, Play (instrument) / Sing (karaoke) / shuffle, rename, delete; songs can be dragged into order, removed, or opened one by one in either mode.
shots.source: harness: tests/frontend/home_harness.html; playlists made through the page's own actions

shots.title: Opening a song
shots.caption: Opening a song: the upload's progress in the dropzone (uploading, then opening), and an overlay on the player until the song is ready.
shots.source: py-shiny rebuild of app.R's page (same bslib 0.12, shiny.js, inst/app/app.js + app.css, inst/dropzone/); tests/frontend/check_app_shell.py

shots.title: Singing, scored
shots.caption: Get Lucky with the original voice at 30 % and a singer on the microphone: the pitch lane (the charted melody in amber, the voice as dots, green / yellow / red by accuracy), the live score and the last line's rating.
shots.source: harness: tests/frontend/karaoke_harness.html (inst/karaoke incl. karaoke-voice.js + karaoke-sing.js, Shiny stub); Get Lucky's lyrics and charted melody from songs/ via tests/reference/karaoke_ref.py; audio: the song's own .wem (wem2ogg); the singer: tests/frontend/sing_synth.js (a synthetic formant voice singing the charted melody, ~12 % of the syllables a semitone off, 5 % left out), fed in as the microphone

shots.title: Results of a sung song
shots.caption: The results card at the end of the song: score and rating, pitch and timing, lines sung, best streak, one bar per line, personal best (the whole song sung by the same synthetic singer, run offline through the same pitch tracker and scorer).
shots.source: harness: tests/frontend/karaoke_harness.html (inst/karaoke incl. karaoke-voice.js + karaoke-sing.js, Shiny stub); Get Lucky's lyrics and charted melody from songs/ via tests/reference/karaoke_ref.py; audio: the song's own .wem (wem2ogg); the singer: tests/frontend/sing_synth.js (a synthetic formant voice singing the charted melody, ~12 % of the syllables a semitone off, 5 % left out), fed in as the microphone
